svg.title: BR Core power inputs merging onto the 5V bus
svg.desc: Four power sources each pass through a 6 A filter clamping at 5.5 V, an ideal-diode eFuse accepting 4.2 to 5.75 V with reverse blocking, and monitoring covering current to 3 A, a power good signal and a 2 V/ms soft start, before merging onto a single 5V bus.
